text:
FORMAL GRIEVANCE -- CONFIDENTIAL

To: People Team, Harrowgate Logistics Ltd
From: Eleanor Whitcombe, Warehouse Shift Supervisor

I am writing to raise a formal grievance under the company grievance
procedure in respect of the handling of my shift allocation over the past
three months.

Since the depot rota was reorganised, I have been moved onto night shifts
at short notice on eleven occasions, on each occasion with less than the
forty-eight hours' notice the rota policy requires. I raised this
informally with my line manager on two occasions and received no written
response either time.

The practical effect has been a reduction in my shift premium of
approximately 1,840.00 GBP over the quarter, and a pattern of rest days
that has made it difficult to arrange childcare. Colleagues on the same
grade have not been reallocated in the same way, which is the part I find
hardest to accept.

For the avoidance of doubt, my personal details as held on file are: date
of birth 12 March 1985, National Insurance number SR 55 01 34 C, home
address 47 Bramble Lane, Sheffield S11 8QT. My salary is paid to the
account held under IBAN GB65 EXMP 9999 9912 3456 78.

I would be grateful for a grievance hearing within the ten working days
set out in the procedure, and I would like to be accompanied by a
colleague at that hearing.

I can be reached at e.whitcombe@example.co.uk or on +44 20 7946 0958.
